query: how many legs does a spider have?
answer: A spider has eight legs, arranged as four pairs, and every known spider species has this count [1][2]. If you see one with six or seven legs, it has usually lost some to injury [1]. Spiders aren't insects. Insects have six legs, while spiders have an extra pair and no antennae [1][2].
